items.title: Agent Browser Test Shows EUR vs Screenshot THB
items.description: Test run of Hostelworld scraping using Agent Browser with mobile viewport showed EUR prices (Nomads €9.52, Base €7.07) while Trevor's screenshot showed THB prices (Nomads THB 1,098, Base THB 999). Possible causes: different dates, room type differences, currency/location-based pricing, or market changes between screenshot and test.

items.title: Broken Puppeteer Scraper Killed
items.description: After Trevor confirmed scraper prices were incorrect (showing THB 999 for Nomads when actual was THB 1,098), broken Puppeteer-based scraper cron job was killed. Replaced with Agent Browser-based solution for accurate real-time price data.

items.title: MEWS Connector API Integration Completed
items.description: Sub-agent completed MEWS Connector API integration for payment polling on branch mews-api (commit 1e19c2d). New convex/mewsConnector.ts (1,312 lines) replaces webhook dependency with 15-minute cron polling. Supports per-hostel credentials, preserves towel deposit cashier filtering, uses AccessToken-only authentication. Added tables: mewsConnectorSyncLog, mewsApiCallLog. MEWS_CONNECTOR_IMPROVEMENTS.md includes 10 detailed recommendations.

items.title: Comprehensive Code Audit Completed
items.description: CODE_AUDIT_REPORT.md generated covering shift reports, reconciliation system, Convex code. Found: 8 critical improvements (N+1 queries, duplicate race condition, transaction isolation), 5 consolidation opportunities (merge MEWS modules, unify reports, standardize soft deletes), 4 error scenarios (timezone, float precision, FK constraints, webhook limits). Top priority: Fix N+1 queries (10x perf improvement), add duplicate protection, implement transaction isolation.
